analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (85,200 KRW) above SMA5 (81,645 KRW) but below SMA20 (87,212 KRW): indicating a short-term rise followed by resistance at the mid-term trend level.
· Significantly below SMA100 (106,222 KRW) and SMA200 (100,870 KRW): maintaining a weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (31.7%): high relative to historical lows but significantly down from highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 35.3 → 42.1 (attempting to exit oversold, now staying neutral): confirming lack of directional conviction.
· MACD histogram 186.5383 → 48.8169 (worsening): signaling strengthening bearish momentum.
· Bollinger Band current price (85,200 KRW) below the middle band (87,212 KRW): suggesting a potential sideways consolidation.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at 83,410 KRW: higher than the 5-day low (76,010 KRW) and above Pivot S1 (75,045 KRW).
· Swing resistance at 89,550 KRW: attempts to break above SMA20 (87,212 KRW) and Pivot PP (86,165 KRW) met resistance.
· 5-day high/low pattern (85,890 KRW / 76,010 KRW), 20-day high/low pattern (97,285 KRW / 76,010 KRW): no clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed, indicating a sideways phase.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.39): contracted volume compared to the last 5-day average, reducing conviction in price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI neutral, MACD worsening, and contracted volume indicate a lack of direction. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
